newsitem.title: ITALY: Gross yields fall at Italian Btp bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Gross yields fall at Italian Btp bond auction.

text.p: Auction results for a third tranche of 2.0 trillion lire worth of three-year Italian Treasury fixed rate bonds (Btp) with an 7.50 pct coupon, and a third tranche of 2.0 trillion lire of five-year Btps carrying a 7.75 pct coupon.
Net Yield 6.15 Pct 6.50 pct 6.38 pct 6.71 pct
Gross Yield 7.11 pct 7.46 pct 7.36 pct 7.71 pct
Note - Comparisons are with a previous auction on Sept 17 of a first tranche of three and five-year Btps.
